description: Source code implementing trigger functionalities for Bosch BMG160 gyroscope sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including interrupt setup, callback handling, and trigger configuration.

methods.name: setup_int
methods.description: Configures the interrupt pin for the device, enabling or disabling it.

methods.name: bmg160_gpio_callback
methods.description: GPIO callback invoked on interrupt, signals the trigger handling thread.

methods.name: bmg160_anymotion_set
methods.description: Sets up the any-motion trigger for the sensor.

methods.name: bmg160_drdy_set
methods.description: Sets up the data-ready trigger for the sensor.

methods.name: bmg160_trigger_set
methods.description: Main function to set sensor triggers based on trigger type.

methods.name: bmg160_handle_int
methods.description: Dispatches interrupt handling based on status register.

methods.name: bmg160_trigger_init
methods.description: Initializes trigger subsystem, configures GPIO and interrupt mapping.
